footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to DaVita: includes $25.0M from discontinued operations; after $332M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 6.5% to $13.6B in 2025. Operating income fell 2.2% to $2.0B, a 15.0% margin.
Net income fell 20.2% to $747M, or $9.84 per share. Operating cash flow was $1.9B and free cash flow $1.3B, versus $1.5B; DaVita returned $1.3B through buybacks.
sources: DaVita Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
